# Agentic Loop Playground

Treat tasks as bounded engineering loops: establish a measurable goal, inspect current evidence, make the smallest allowed change, verify with deterministic checks, use an independent checker, persist the result, and stop when acceptance criteria pass or human judgment is required.

This workspace uses Node.js 20+ and the built-in `node:test` runner. Run `npm run validate` after changes. The `practice/` scenario intentionally starts with failing behavior; repair production code rather than weakening tests.

Never fabricate issue, pull request, review, or test evidence. Never auto-merge a pull request. Escalate ambiguous domain rules, credentials, security policy, destructive operations, and exhausted iteration or AI-credit budgets.
